name: lian-platform-server
description: LIAN backend runtime using the Redis object-native data model

scripts.check: node scripts/validate-backend-structure.js && node scripts/check-encoding-contamination.js && node scripts/check-code-smells.js && node scripts/check-context-docs.js && node scripts/check-docs-maintenance.js && npm run docs:check-generated && node scripts/test-route-registry.js && node scripts/test-actor-source-contracts.js && node scripts/test-place-sheet-contract.js && node scripts/test-place-ref-stable-id-contract.js
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:routes && npm run test:route-manifest && npm run test:route-registry && npm run test:ops-actions && npm run test:public-entry-checks && npm run test:nodebb-boundary && npm run test:object-native && npm run verify:redis && npm run verify:redis:auth && npm run audit:feed-images
scripts.verify:deploy-safe: npm run check && npm run test:routes && npm run test:route-manifest && npm run test:route-registry && npm run test:ops-actions && npm run test:public-entry-checks && npm run test:nodebb-boundary

redis.runtime: Redis object keys are the source of truth for normal reads and writes.
redis.legacyBulkKeys: Legacy bulk JSON keys are intentionally absent from a healthy object-native runtime.
redis.legacyScriptsPurpose: Historical migration and bulk-verification helpers only; do not use for normal runtime verification.
